name: @ananay-nag/mcp-decorators
description: Model Context Protocol implementation for TypeScript with decorators

scripts.build:esm: mkdir -p dist/esm && echo '{"type": "module"}' > dist/esm/package.json && tsc -p tsconfig.prod.json
scripts.build:cjs: mkdir -p dist/cjs && echo '{"type": "commonjs"}' > dist/cjs/package.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json
scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs
scripts.build:publish: rm -rf dist/ *mcp*.tgz && npm run build && npm pack
